hc-doha-1: Cleansing the mind’s mirror with the dust of the Guru’s lotus feet, I narrate the pure glory of Raghuvira, giver of the four fruits of life.
hc-doha-2: Knowing this body as without wisdom, I remember the Son of the Wind — grant me strength, wisdom, and learning; remove affliction and impurity.
hc-01: Victory to Hanuman, ocean of wisdom and virtue! Victory to the Lord of vanaras who illumines the three worlds!
hc-02: Messenger of Rama, abode of unmatched strength — known as Anjani’s son and the Wind-god’s child.
hc-03: Great hero of valour, thunderbolt-limbed — remover of wicked thought, companion of pure wisdom.
hc-04: Golden-hued, beautifully adorned, earrings gleaming, curly locks flowing.
hc-05: In hand the mace and banner shine; the sacred munja thread adorns the shoulder.
hc-06: Child of Shankara’s grace, son of Kesari — of great radiance, worshipped by the world.
hc-07: Learned, virtuous, most clever — ever eager to serve Rama’s work.
hc-08: Delighting in the Lord’s tales — Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita dwell in your heart.
hc-09: In subtle form you appeared to Sita; in fierce form you set Lanka ablaze.
hc-10: In mighty form you destroyed demons and fulfilled Rama’s purpose.
hc-11: Bringing the life-herb you revived Lakshmana — Raghuvira embraced you in joy.
hc-12: Raghupati praised you greatly: you are dear to me as Bharata, my brother.
hc-13: Even the thousand-mouthed one sings your glory — so saying, the Lord of Shri embraces you.
hc-14: Sanaka and sages, Brahma and the lords of seers, Narada, Sharada, and the serpent-king…
hc-15: Yama, Kubera, the guardians of directions — how far can poets and scholars recount?
hc-16: You blessed Sugriva — uniting him with Rama, restoring his throne.
hc-17: Vibhishana heeded your counsel — became lord of Lanka; the world knows this.
hc-18: The sun a thousand yojanas away — you took it as a sweet fruit.
hc-19: With the Lord’s ring in your mouth you crossed the ocean — no wonder.
hc-20: All hard tasks of the world become easy by your grace.
hc-21: You guard Rama’s door — none enters without leave.
hc-22: All joy is found in your refuge — with you as guardian, there is no fear.
hc-23: You alone contain your own radiance — your roar shakes the three worlds.
hc-24: Ghosts and spirits dare not near when the Great Hero’s name is heard.
hc-25: Constant remembrance of brave Hanuman destroys disease and all pain.
hc-26: Hanuman frees from distress those who offer mind, deed, and word in devotion.
hc-27: Rama, the ascetic king over all — you arranged all his works.
hc-28: Whoever brings a heartfelt wish receives boundless fruit of life.
hc-29: Your glory spans the four ages — a famous light upon the world.
hc-30: Guardian of saints, destroyer of demons, beloved of Rama.
hc-31: Giver of eight siddhis and nine treasures — such was Mother Janaki’s boon.
hc-32: The elixir of Rama is with you — forever remain Raghupati’s servant.
hc-33: Through your worship one attains Rama and forgets sorrows of many births.
hc-34: At life’s end one goes to Raghuvara’s city — born again as a devotee of Hari.
hc-35: Hold no other deity in the heart — serving Hanuman brings every joy.
hc-36: Remembering mighty Hanuman cuts distress and ends all pain.
hc-37: Victory, victory, victory to Lord Hanuman — grace us as a master would.
hc-38: Whoever recites a hundred times is freed from bondage into great joy.
hc-39: Whoever reads this Hanuman Chalisa attains fulfillment — Lord Shiva is witness.
hc-40: Tulsidas is forever Hari’s servant — O Lord, make your abode in the heart.
hc-doha-3: Son of the Wind, remover of distress, form of auspiciousness — dwell in the heart with Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita, O king of gods.
